Frequently Asked Questions

Is there a free trial available?

Yes, we offer a 14-day free trial with full access to all features — no credit card required to get started.

Can I cancel my subscription anytime?

Absolutely. You can cancel your subscription anytime from your dashboard with no hidden fees.

Does it integrate with my existing tools?

Yes, it connects seamlessly with popular CRMs, email platforms, and productivity tools you're already using.

Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan later?

Of course. You can switch plans anytime from your account settings, and changes take effect immediately.

Do you offer customer support?

Yes, our support team is available via chat and email to help with any questions, anytime you need us.
